description: Defines classes and methods for handling Beacon Metrics Query TLV structures in WFA Map protocol, including tlvBeaconMetricsQuery and cApChannelReports.

classes.name: tlvBeaconMetricsQuery
classes.description: Represents a Beacon Metrics Query TLV with methods to access and modify its fields.

classes.name: cApChannelReports
classes.description: Represents a list of AP channel reports within the Beacon Metrics Query.

methods.name: tlvBeaconMetricsQuery
methods.description: Constructor initializing from buffer or shared pointer.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the TLV.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: associated_sta_mac
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the associated station.

methods.name: ap_channel_reports_list
methods.description: Accesses the list of AP channel reports by index.
